study type: Case report with in vitro functional analysis
exposure: De novo gain-of-function variant in the CACNA1D gene (p.(G1169D))
outcome: Pronounced activity-enhancing gating changes in CaV1.3 channels (shift of channel activation and inactivation to more hyperpolarized potentials, impaired channel inactivation and deactivation)
cohort: Two children with a novel de novo gain-of-function CACNA1D variant p.(G1169D) presenting with neurodevelopmental disease symptoms.
finding: A novel de novo CACNA1D variant p.(G1169D) was identified in two children with neurodevelopmental disease, showing pronounced activity-enhancing gating changes in CaV1.3 channels in vitro and variable clinical severity.
